decisions.reason: The format reader and writer plug-ins extend the established offer, already have their own web page, and cost little to maintain, so keeping the option open is cheap while their value is still being revealed.

The building digital twin service is only mentioned on the website and its demand is still uncertain, but uncertainty is high and the carrying cost is moderate for a firm already doing R&D in this area, so the option is worth keeping a while longer.
The authentication and delegation service overlaps with the identity service E and could be merged into it, but it is cheap to keep while it is still unclear which of the two will carry the value.
The open GIS application framework is close to the core offer and serves as a platform for many projects, so its option value is high and its incremental cost is low.

The identity service was launched with explicit promotion of seamless integration of GeoIT applications and fits the firm's strategy of integrating with enterprise systems, so it is too early to treat the option as resolved.
